rules: Exactly one authoritative evidence directory per RunID+seed.
Classify by key-file hashes and identity, never by directory name.
EXACT_DUPLICATE = prop_evt byte-identical + chain_report JSON semantically identical + run.out identical after stripping start-time/pid/outdir.
OLD_BINARY_REFERENCE = manifest binary_sha256 differs from the authoritative binary.
TRUNCATED = prop_evt gzip stream not at EOF although a done marker exists.
INTERRUPTED = no done marker, no live writer (stale mtime) and/or gzip not at EOF.
ACTIVE = no done marker, gzip not at EOF, fresh mtime (live writer).
REVIEW_REQUIRED = same/unknown binary with differing evidence and no classifying identity evidence.
